name: Forest Research Institute Malaysia Forest Park Selangor
description: Just 16 km northwest of Kuala Lumpur, this 545-hectare forest park was planted from scratch in the 1920s on land stripped bare by tin mining. A century on, it is a tall, mature lowland rainforest, threaded with walking trails, ponds and the research buildings of a working forestry institute. It shows how a ruined landscape can be brought back to life.
